channel.title: AI Changelog
channel.description: New AI and data science papers, repos, models, tools and news.

item.title: [news] Google's AI answers reducing search traffic by 40%
item.description: Google's AI answers reduce clicks to outside websites by about 40 percent while appearing on more than half of tracked US keywords.

item.title: [news] Managed NVIDIA Dynamo on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Inference
item.description: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Inference now supports managed NVIDIA Dynamo for distributed inference, enabling multi-node serving with automatic fault recovery.

item.title: [news] External sandboxes for coding agents
item.description: External sandboxes for coding agents provide a safer way to execute local code and protect against prompt injection attacks or mistakes.

item.title: [news] Reducing token costs and latency in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore JSON workloads
item.description: Three composable strategies for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore reduce token costs and latency when processing multi-megabyte JSON payloads in production agents.

item.title: [news] GPT‑6.2 Astra and GPT‑6.2 Sol
item.description: OpenAI introduces GPT-6.2 Astra for hard projects and GPT-6.2 Sol as an efficient, versatile model for everyday work.

item.title: [news] Harvard researchers find AI coding agents shifted the bottleneck to code review
item.description: A Harvard study reveals that AI coding agents increased code output by 30 percent while making code reviews take 49 percent longer.

item.title: [news] Cut generative AI costs: Code for rules, models for judgment
item.description: A guide for generative AI workloads helps determine when to use deterministic code, constrained decisions, or right-sized models to reduce costs.

item.title: [news] Amazon SageMaker AI real-time endpoints now support KV cache aware routing
item.description: Amazon SageMaker AI real-time endpoints now support KV cache-aware routing to direct prompts to instances holding the longest cached match.

item.title: [paper] Ambient LLMs: Data-Efficient Supervised Fine-tuning via Temperature Matching
item.description: Ambient SFT matches high-temperature distributions with a pre-trained teacher model, improving domain adaptation and instruction-tuning while preventing overfitting.

item.title: [paper] Spool: Low-Latency Streaming Inference for Hybrid Vision-Language Models
item.description: Spool is a training-free framework that caches per-frame state transformations to achieve low-latency streaming inference in hybrid vision-language models.

item.title: [paper] FastFrames: Video Generation at Interactive Latency
item.description: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate frames based on new observations and inputs, making them a promising medium for interactive visual experiences. However, existing models are orders of magnitude too slow for fluid interaction.

item.title: [paper] StringQFT: A Multiuse Textbook Resource for AI-Assisted Theoretical Physics
item.description: StringQFT is an 18-volume textbook collection and infrastructure resource designed to support AI-assisted theoretical physics research and agents.

item.title: [paper] An inexact stochastic variance-reduced gradient method for constrained convex finite-sum optimization
item.description: An inexact stochastic variance-reduced gradient method improves first-order oracle complexity for solving constrained convex finite-sum optimization problems.

item.title: [paper] Do LLM Agents Still Need to Be Told How to Self-Improve?
item.description: Capable frozen LLM agents can autonomously construct context-based self-learning algorithms from basic resources and a general goal, yielding text artifacts that transfer to new game and 3D navigation tasks.

item.title: [paper] What Does a Bias Head Measure? Non-Identifiability in Head-Level Bias Attribution
item.description: An audit of social bias attribution methods in large language models finds that head-level bias metrics are non-identifiable and fail to reduce unfairness.

item.title: [paper] Higher-Scoring Coding Models Did Not Get More Work Done
item.description: Empirical analysis of 297 users finds that switching to higher-scoring coding models does not significantly increase real-world software engineering productivity or pull request merge rates.

item.title: [paper] EviSlide-MIL: Multi-Query Pooling and Shared Prediction for Class-Incremental Whole-Slide Image Classification
item.description: EviSlide-MIL is a class-incremental whole-slide image classification framework that uses multi-query pooling and a shared prediction module to learn new tumor subtypes while preventing catastrophic forgetting.

item.title: [paper] Multimodal Masked Diffusion Autoencoder for Modeling Impaired Driving
item.description: ID-MAE is a multimodal masked-diffusion autoencoder that improves driver impairment prediction by jointly reconstructing gaze, trajectory, and impairment tokens from driving-simulator data.

item.title: [paper] Learning Grounded Reasoning from Human Gaze
item.description: GGR is a vision-language reasoning model that uses human gaze data as a spatial exploration prior to improve visual grounding and task accuracy across chart understanding and counting tasks.

item.title: [paper] Distortion-Free Semantic Watermarks for Black-Box Generative Models
item.description: Semantic watermarking algorithm provides provably distortion-free watermarks for black-box generative models that remain robust to content-preserving image transformations like compression and cropping.

item.title: [paper] Reading Scene States: Uncovering Safety Failures in Vision-Language Models
item.description: SceneSafetyBench and the S3TA attack framework reveal a security vulnerability where vision-language models generate harmful assistance when prompted with scene-state descriptions instead of direct requests.

item.title: [paper] Fine-Tuning Gemma 4 Edge Models for MATLAB Signal-Processing Code with SFT and QLoRA on a Laptop iGPU
item.description: Supervised fine-tuning using LoRA and QLoRA on a laptop integrated GPU adapts Gemma 4 edge models to correctly generate digital signal processing code in MATLAB.

item.title: [paper] Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI): A Federated Identity, Trust, Attestation, and Accountability Architecture for Cross-Organization Autonomous AI Agents
item.description: Agent Trust Infrastructure is a framework-independent security architecture using public key infrastructure and remote attestation to verify cross-organizational identity and authorization for collaborative AI agents.

item.title: [paper] Learned versus Kinematic Trajectory Prediction under Reduced Observation Frequency
item.description: Evaluation of trajectory prediction models shows that learned recurrent neural networks maintain their accuracy advantage over kinematic models even when observation history frequencies drop down to 1 Hz.

item.title: [paper] Structure--Residual Inductive Biases for Language Model Pretraining
item.description: Structure-residual inductive biases combining boundary bottlenecks and continuous geometry regularization improve language model pretraining efficiency by separating global structure from local realization details.

item.title: [paper] WoRD: Diffusion-Based Posterior Inference for Online Goal Recognition
item.description: Waypoint Recognition with Diffusion is a diffusion-based inference method that infers an agent's intended goal from partial observations by running denoising chains per candidate goal.

item.title: [paper] Retrieval-Augmented Correction for Generalist Medical Image Segmentation
item.description: GRACE is a retrieval-augmented medical image segmentation refiner that edits input masks using context from a shared knowledge base of verified prior cases.

item.title: [paper] Any2Building: Unifying Point Clouds and Images for Building Reconstruction via Shared Spatial Queries
item.description: Any2Building is a unified framework utilizing shared spatial queries to reconstruct Level of Detail 2 building models from partial point clouds, overhead images, or both.

item.title: [paper] Polarity Composition Hypothesis: Causal Evidence from Negation in NLI
item.description: The polarity composition hypothesis is a causal model for how language models process negation in natural language inference, supported by identified causally effective subspaces.

item.title: [paper] Fold Weighting for Cross-Validation Under Continuous Distributional Drift
item.description: Sliding-window cross-validation with advance-fixed fold weights minimizes a convex bound on deployment risk under continuous distributional drift by shifting weight toward recent data.

item.title: [paper] Say Less, Hallucinate Less? Diagnosing and Restoring Object Coverage in Preference-Optimized Vision-Language Models
item.description: Base-guided object-category restoration appends high-confidence base-only object categories to preference-optimized vision-language model captions without training to recover lost recall.

item.title: [paper] Déjà View: A Shared Working-Memory Model for Visual Tasks
item.description: A working-memory model combining dynamic activity with temporary feature associations performs multiple visual tasks and demonstrates how errors depend on task demands and image history.

item.title: [paper] Inference after coding agents
item.description: A correction procedure for AI coding agent analyses uses data subsampling and agent replay to detect and correct distortions caused by selective inference during empirical research.

item.title: [news] Not Everything Needs an LLM
item.description: Decision models provide fast, structured, and probabilistic answers for simpler tasks as a cost-effective alternative to large language models.

item.title: [paper] Attribution Through the Decoder: Prediction-Space Explanations for Structured Outputs
item.description: Tangent attribution methods account for fixed decoders when explaining structured outputs like angles and rotations, improving explanation accuracy by avoiding irrelevant raw coordinate attributions.

item.title: [paper] MoE--LoRA Methods for Multilingual Adaptation: A Systematic Empirical Study
item.description: An empirical study evaluating eight low-rank adaptation methods across 200 languages demonstrates that these methods improve translation fit and benefit low-resource languages most.

item.title: [paper] TextSphere: Efficient Text-to-Image Generation via Shared Hyperspherical Alignment and Uniformity
item.description: TextSphere is an efficient text-to-image generative framework that extends Sphere Encoder with language conditioning and cross-modal alignment to improve generation quality while using fewer sampling steps.

item.title: [paper] Learning Stratified Policies for Inference-Time Objectives
item.description: Stratified policies allocate the inference-time sample budget across a population of learned LoRA adapters on a shared language model backbone, improving pass@k performance on reasoning tasks.

item.title: [paper] VIVID: Beyond Static Multi-Image Reasoning with Localized Visual Differences and Textual Entity Dynamics in Video MLLMs
item.description: VIVID is a video multimodal large language model that uses keyframes and inter-frame patch differences to preserve localized motion and event order for efficient video question answering.

item.title: [paper] Capability Composition in Heterogeneous Teams via Barrier-Guided Diffusion Sampling
item.description: Capability Composition via Barrier-Guided Diffusion Sampling is a method that enforces physical trajectory constraints to generate cooperative behaviors in heterogeneous robot teams without needing demonstration data.

item.title: [paper] $π^4$: A Foundation Model for 4D Scene Geometry and Motion
item.description: This unified foundation model enables the recovery of dense geometry, camera poses, and object tracking from diverse, uncalibrated observations in 4D scenes using a shared geometry and motion branch architecture.

item.title: [paper] TCP4D: A Unified Tool-Center-Point Tracking and Generation Model for Robot Manipulation
item.description: Robot manipulation videos provide a rich visual experience, yet recovering robot action and gripper-state annotations from RGB observations still remains challenging.

item.title: [paper] Mind the Gap: A Deployed Multi-Agent System for Documentation Maintenance
item.description: TriAgent is a deployed multi-agent system that continuously extracts operational signals from support tickets and code discrepancies to automatically repair outdated software documentation.

item.title: [paper] GameRealm: Grounding Visual Learning in Interactive Games
item.description: GameRealm is a large-scale dataset providing synchronized game-native visual supervision, depth, camera parameters, and audio across diverse gameplay footage to strengthen visual foundation models.

item.title: [paper] RSI-Prime: Training Models to Train Models
item.description: RSI-Prime is a dataset of model-training experimental trajectories with decision-level quality annotations, designed to help large language models autonomously conduct training and improve target models.

item.title: [paper] Correcting Flows with Marginal Matching
item.description: Marginal Matching is a training-based predictor-corrector framework for flow matching models that corrects forward sampling steps toward the backward ODE's marginal distribution to improve generation quality.

item.title: [paper] A Neural Envelope Method for Rapid Gradient-based Optimum Takeoff Trajectory Design
item.description: A neural envelope method combines physics-constrained generative adversarial networks with a neural convex envelope to transform complex, constrained trajectory optimization problems into unconstrained convex optimizations.

item.title: [paper] Where Should Physics Enter? Information, Identifiability and Calibration in Probabilistic Sea Surface Temperature Forecasting
item.description: A study on probabilistic sea surface temperature forecasting tests where advection-diffusion priors must enter a neural network, finding that learned velocities fail to recover true currents and offer no reliable forecast benefit.

item.title: [paper] The Illusion of Grounding: Do Vision-Language Models Weigh Retrieved Text and Images Like an Ideal Observer?
item.description: Vision-language models dataset called GIB-200K is proposed to measure how models combine text and image evidence, revealing that tested models often over-weight text.

item.title: [paper] Which Past Matters? Training History and Multi-Forecast Horizon in Equity Transformers
item.description: Study on intraday equity prediction examines how training history length interacts with forecast horizons, showing that multi-recency ensembles outperform individual configurations at specific horizons.

item.title: [paper] Get Hint-Augmented GRPO Done Right Through Activation Steering
item.description: Activation Steering for Hinting is a method that injects a trainable steering vector during inference to reproduce hint-conditioned behavior without creating a training-inference context mismatch.

item.title: [paper] Dynamic Task Allocation with Dialogue
item.description: Communication-augmented Bayesian task-allocation framework uses dialogue to reduce uncertainty and improve efficiency in dynamic, partially observable multi-agent environments.

item.title: [paper] Auditing a Learned Simulator for Legged Robots: The Robotic World Model on ANYmal D
item.description: Audited learning simulator for legged robots shows that training on the model's own rollouts improves long-term prediction while one-step training misjudges design choices.

item.title: [paper] Nunchi: Ears Help Eyes in Multi-Party Conversations
item.description: Nunchi is a framework that combines gaze geometry with conversational cues like speech transcripts using a vision-language model to accurately identify attended persons in multi-party scenes.

item.title: [paper] LUTBench: Benchmarking Text-Driven Photographic Look Transfer
item.description: LUTBench is a benchmarking framework of 455,000 image pairs designed to evaluate text-driven photographic look transfer methods under a shared protocol.

item.title: [paper] Large-scale Neuron Community Discovery Reveals Neuron-Sparse Behaviors in Language Models
item.description: Unsupervised neuron community discovery method finds recurrent, causally necessary neuron groups in language models that support computations like grammatical agreement and arithmetic.

item.title: [paper] Event-Based Dynamic Lip Region Estimation During Speech
item.description: Event-based lip region estimation model uses a continuous-time recurrent network to predict a dense heatmap over the lip region from full event frames for speech applications.

item.title: [paper] FMT: Lossless Image Compression in a Fixed Number of Parallel Steps
item.description: The Fixed-step Multiscale Tree (FMT) format achieves highly efficient, fixed-time decoding of images by utilizing a coarse-to-fine tree structure and parallel GPU prediction mechanisms.

item.title: [paper] Natural Language Programming: Rethinking Language, Memory, and Cognition in the Era of Generative AI
item.description: Theoretical framework introduces Natural Language Programming to conceptualize prompts as dynamic cognitive artifacts that function as executable media in human-AI workflows.

item.title: [paper] Hidden-State Similarity Predicts Re-Elicitation After Inoculation Prompting
item.description: Researchers find that model prompts are more likely to re-elicit suppressed harmful behaviors when they produce hidden activation states similar to those of inoculation prompts.

item.title: [paper] What's in a Tree ? Hierarchical $n$-gram models as controlled approximators of language
item.description: Tree-grams are hierarchical autoregressive generative n-gram models that serve as interpretable and scalable language approximators, outperforming existing n-gram baselines and improving hyperparameter transfer robustness.

item.title: [paper] BugGen 2.0: Rethinking the Roles of LLMs for Scalable RTL Bug Synthesis
item.description: BugGen 2.0 is an automated RTL bug synthesis framework that uses deterministic algorithms for structural analysis and large language models for localized semantic rewriting to generate compilation-ready bug datasets efficiently.

item.title: [paper] Event-Based Person Detection for Maritime UAV Search
item.description: Event-based person detection uses event cameras and recurrent vision transformers to improve small target localization in maritime search and rescue missions under motion blur and low light conditions.

item.title: [paper] Transfer Once, Ask Locally: Compact Audio-Visual Memory for On-Device Question Answering
item.description: This training-free audio-visual framework constructs a compact memory representation using Monte Carlo Shapley valuation to enable efficient on-device question answering with reduced latency and bandwidth requirements.

item.title: [paper] Learning to Undo: Transfer Reinforcement Learning under State Space Transformations
item.description: A new transfer reinforcement learning algorithm learns an undo map between source and target state spaces using feature statistics, achieving improved sample efficiency on continuous control and Atari tasks.

item.title: [paper] Colombo: A Frontier-to-Frontier Autoresearch System for Oracle-Based Optimization
item.description: Colombo is an autonomous AI research system that uses adversarial co-ascent, formal mathematical verification, and self-organization to establish optimal rates for oracle-based optimization problems.

item.title: [paper] UnrealEvent: Synthetic Dataset Generation and Annotation for Event-Based Vision
item.description: UnrealEvent is a synthetic dataset generation pipeline built in Unreal Engine 5.5 that converts rendered level sequences into paired event representations and bounding-box annotations for event-based vision.

item.title: [paper] Pareto-Informed Smart "Predict, then Optimize" for Multi-Objective Combinatorial Problems
item.description: A Pareto-aware decision-focused learning extension for multi-objective combinatorial optimization uses the true Pareto Frontier and preference vectors to outperform traditional mean squared error prediction baselines.

item.title: [paper] Runtime Verification of Multiple Natural Language Criteria for Agent Governance
item.description: VFM is a tree-attention verifier pretrained on a large criteria corpus to efficiently evaluate and score multiple natural language safety and governance criteria for AI agents in parallel.

item.title: [paper] Amortizing Tempered Sampling with Corrected Self-Training
item.description: Sequential Score Sampler uses corrected self-training across tempered targets to amortize repeated sampling from un-normalized distributions with improved efficiency and accuracy.

item.title: [paper] The Resolution Hypothesis: Agent Evolution's Key Is Identifying Improvements
item.description: Analysis of agent evolution across seven methods and six models reveals that evolution is bottlenecked by noisy evaluations that fail to reliably identify helpful artifact improvements.

item.title: [paper] Values Shape What Self-Improving Coding Agents Build
item.description: Evaluation of human values in self-improving coding agents demonstrates that explicit value statements significantly alter agent performance, solution complexity, and algorithmic approach.

item.title: [paper] Deep Reinforcement Learning for Heat Pump and Underfloor Heating Control: An End-to-End Case Study
item.description: End-to-end case study of a deep reinforcement learning controller in a residential building demonstrates successful real-world management of an underfloor heating and heat pump system.

item.title: [paper] RFW-S: Everyday Deformable Objects with Independent Simulation Verification
item.description: RFW-S is a large-scale dataset of simulation-verified everyday deformable objects with an automated generation pipeline to support physically grounded robotic manipulation learning.

item.title: [paper] FrameRouter: Frame Budget Routing for Long-Video Understanding on Video-MME-v2 and Beyond
item.description: FrameRouter is a training-free test-time framework that improves long-video question answering by selectively allocating variable frame budgets based on individual query evidence demands.

item.title: [paper] ReTouchGS: Ultralight Render-free Aesthetic Color Enhancement and Transfer for 3D Gaussian Splatting
item.description: ReTouchGS is a lightweight framework that uses a shared refinement network to perform reference-free aesthetic color enhancement and transfer for pretrained 3D Gaussian Splatting models without rendering.

item.title: [paper] Refin3R: Geometry-Guided Refinement for Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
item.description: Refin3R is a geometry-guided refinement framework that propagates Structure-from-Motion points through a dual-branch architecture to produce dense, accurate point maps in feed-through 3D reconstruction.

item.title: [paper] Magflow: Differentiable Simulation of Industrial-Grade 6D Magnetic Levitation
item.description: Magflow is a fully differentiable GPU-parallel simulator that enables zero-shot transfer of learned neural controllers for industrial-grade six-degree-of-freedom magnetic levitation systems.

item.title: [paper] Reversing the text is not reversing the path: a fixed-text measure without a zero, and an assembly-order comparison that vanishes identically
item.description: Mathematical analysis of text-reversal scoring measures demonstrates that fixed-text evaluations lack a natural zero and evaluates the contributions of causal order using autoregressive models.

item.title: [paper] Wall-to-wall maps of canopy height and aboveground carbon across the Atlantic Forest
item.description: Deep learning maps for canopy height and aboveground carbon density across the Brazilian Atlantic Forest provide high-resolution environmental data for regional carbon accounting.

item.title: [paper] ForecastGym: A Live, Controlled, and Replayable Benchmark for Forecasting Agents
item.description: ForecastGym is a benchmark for web-retrieval-based forecasting agents that records and replays frozen search evidence to evaluate real-world prediction accuracy.

item.title: [paper] Uncovering the Invisible in Routine Radiology: Cross-Modal Detection of MRI-Verified Soft-Tissue Pathologies from CBCT via Physics-Guided 3D Self-Supervised Learning
item.description: A physics-guided deep learning pipeline extracts sub-visual radiographic signatures of soft-tissue pathologies from routine CBCT scans for opportunistic screening.

item.title: [paper] Variance Restoration over Covariance Rank: Memory-Budgeted Analytic Continual Learning
item.description: Coordinate-Restored Analytic Continual Learning is a memory-efficient continual learning method that uses factorized covariance to match dense readouts while cutting persistent state by over ninety percent.

item.title: [paper] When Anchors Shift the Target: Advantage-Gated Adaptation for Diffusion Reinforcement Learning
item.description: Advantage-Gated Adaptation is a parameter-free gating method for reinforcement learning that decouples positive target fitting from negative repulsive gradients in diffusion models.

item.title: [paper] Automated Annotation-Free Synthetic Data Generation for Underwater Litter Detection: A Comparison of Generative Approaches
item.description: An automated zero-annotation pipeline inserts class-conditioned trash objects into real underwater frames to generate fully labeled synthetic training data for marine object detection.

item.title: [paper] Storing the Gemma 4 K=V Cache Once: Exact Global-KV Memory Savings in a Paged Serving Engine with Unchanged Attention Kernels
item.description: A memory-saving technique for the Gemma 4 serving engine stores a single compact projection row to reduce steady decode KV memory requirements.

item.title: [paper] M3OPD-Reasoner: An Open Recipe for Post-Training Multimodal Reasoning with Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
item.description: Multimodal Model Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation Reasoner is an open recipe for post-training vision-language models across image and video reasoning domains.

item.title: [paper] Check Your Blind Spots: Decision-Guided Perception by Probing the Planner with Hypothetical Objects
item.description: Decision-Guided Speculative Perception is an adaptive-resolution perception method that uses hypothetical object probes to allocate high-resolution compute only where planner decisions change.

item.title: [paper] TPHC: Improving Hyper-Connections with Tensor-Parallel Grouped Updates
item.description: Tensor-Parallel Grouped Updates improve Transformer hyper-connections by routing separate residual streams to tensor-parallel shards, enhancing model expressiveness without adding parameters.

item.title: [paper] When a Larger Guidance Scale Repairs Text-to-Video Failures and When It Does Not
item.description: A measurement study of text-to-video diffusion models finds that raising the classifier-free guidance scale repairs rare composition failures but fails for negations and late events, and introduces a demand score to predict this effectiveness in advance.

item.title: [paper] PeriaTrace: Tooth-Level Grounding Diagnosis and Patient-Facing Explanations from Periapical Radiographs
item.description: PeriaTrace is a three-stage framework that generates tooth-level diagnoses, visual grounding, and patient-friendly explanations from periapical radiographs to speed up endodontic reporting and improve patient communication.

item.title: [paper] PhysScope: Agentic Multimodal Physics Reasoning with Grounded Visual Memory
item.description: PhysScope is an inference-time visual harness for vision-language models that enforces explicit physical scopes, states, and conditions to enable self-correction and improve accuracy in physics reasoning.

item.title: [paper] Tracking Ethological Behaviors of Broiler Chickens Through Computer Vision (YoloV11) Using an Android Mobile Device
item.description: A computer vision model using YOLOv11 and deployed on Android via TFLite classifies broiler chicken ethological behaviors like sitting, standing, and feeding to support continuous welfare monitoring in poultry farming.

item.title: [paper] CARE: Conversational Affective Response Retrieval for Internet Memes
item.description: CARE is a conversational affective response retrieval framework that combines an emotion-enhanced CLIP retriever with a Jina-based reranker to select contextually and emotionally relevant internet memes for online discussions.

item.title: [paper] NVIDIA Kumo Tabular: Pushing the Accuracy$\unicode{8211}$Efficiency Frontier for Tabular Prediction
item.description: NVIDIA Kumo Tabular is a family of open tabular foundation models pretrained on artificial tables that achieves high accuracy and speed on classification and regression tasks without requiring task-specific training.

item.title: [paper] Residual-Guided Lightweight Reinforcement Learning for Risk-Aware Trajectory Selection with a Frozen World Model
item.description: A residual-guided reinforcement learning framework fine-tunes a lightweight policy for risk-aware trajectory selection using a frozen world model and a fixed candidate bank to improve autonomous driving performance.

item.title: [paper] The Rhythm of Generated Video: Latent Chunking Leaves Periodic Traces in Compressed Bitstreams
item.description: An analysis of causal video autoencoders reveals that they leave periodic bitstream rhythms that can be used as a training-free method to reliably detect AI-generated videos and identify their underlying architectures.

item.title: [paper] CAST: Calibrating Correspondences for Training-Free Biomedical In-Context Segmentation
item.description: CAST is a training-free framework built on a frozen DINOv3 backbone that calibrates fine-grained feature correspondences using stability and coherence tests to improve biomedical in-context image segmentation.

item.title: [paper] RagHarnessDebugger: Jev-Guided Agentic RAG in Contract Inference Repair Auditing
item.description: RagHarnessDebugger is a debugging framework that records and audits every repair decision in retrieval-augmented generation systems to uncover hidden failure patterns and improve contract inference accuracy.

item.title: [paper] How Web Research Agents Interpret User Priorities
item.description: Study analyzing how OpenAI and Anthropic web research agents interpret user priorities finds that their criteria for judging companies vary significantly despite focusing on the requested goal.

item.title: [paper] Structured AI ideation yields physical strategies for epithelial barrier repair
item.description: Abelio is an AI system that generates novel research hypotheses by reformulating objectives and exploring elements outside conventional disciplinary boundaries, outperforming frontier language models in quantitative tests.

item.title: [paper] SpikWM: Efficient End-to-End Spiking World Modeling for Visual Planning
item.description: SpikWM is an end-to-end spiking world model that uses sparse regional encoding and causal membrane prediction for efficient visual planning and high-success execution across multiple robotic tasks.

item.title: [paper] Large Language Models Have Not Yet Transformed Science
item.description: Empirical analysis of 2.5 million academic papers reveals that large language model adoption since late 2022 has not fundamentally transformed overall pre-existing scientific publishing trends.

item.title: [paper] VITAL: A Framework for Validating Agentic AI in Pharmaceutical Drug Development and Clinical Trial Operations
item.description: VITAL is a validation framework designed to govern and monitor agentic artificial intelligence systems in pharmaceutical drug development and clinical trial operations.

item.title: [paper] SEAM: Computer-Use Agents Know the Harm Between Screens, and Commit It Anyway
item.description: SEAM is a multi-screen benchmark revealing that general-purpose computer-use agents frequently execute cross-screen compositional harms even when they recognize the safety risks involved.

item.title: [paper] Rescaling OLS-Merged Adapters To Improve Personalized Image Generation
item.description: Rescaling method for ordinary least squares-merged image generation adapters compensates for signal shrinkage caused by overlapping task activations, improving subject fidelity and style transfer.

item.title: [paper] MI-Hyper: Generating Multiple Instance Models for Weight Space Transfer Learning in Histopathology via Mixed Tasks Pretrained HyperNetwork
item.description: MI-Hyper is a pretrained hypernetwork that generates multiple instance learning weights for zero-shot whole-slide image prediction, substantially improving performance across hundreds of pathology tasks.

item.title: [paper] CodeReel: Accelerating Code-to-Video Agents with Exact Frame Reuse and Blocking-Aware Scheduling
item.description: CodeReel is an execution layer for video-coding agents that accelerates code-to-video generation by using exact frame reuse and blocking-aware scheduling to reduce wait times.

item.title: [paper] High-Dimensional Black-Box Optimization via Guidance Sampling of Diffusion Models
item.description: BReaD is a guidance sampling framework that uses a Gaussian process surrogate to optimize high-dimensional black-box objectives with diffusion models without requiring pre-labeled training datasets.

item.title: [paper] Training-Free Building Change Detection with Example-Induced Discriminants
item.description: Linear Induced Discriminants is a training-free framework that turns regional feature contrasts into a reusable linear building classifier for accurate change detection.

item.title: [paper] Hierarchical Diffusion Transformer for End-to-End Image Generation
item.description: Hierarchical Diffusion Transformers group related tokens progressively to achieve efficient end-to-end image generation with high semantic structure and quality.

item.title: [paper] DDSL: Iterative Self-Labeling for Financial Market States
item.description: DDSL is an iterative self-labeling framework that couples a Viterbi labeler with a Transformer classifier to construct robust financial market states.

item.title: [paper] Is model self-assessment enough for diverse LVLM ensembles?
item.description: Simple training and parameter-free self-assessment approaches enable diverse large vision-language model ensembles to outperform their individual constituent models.

item.title: [paper] ResoLUT: Distilling Residual Networks into Lookup-Table Networks
item.description: ResoLUT is a method for distilling trained residual networks layer by layer into lookup-table networks to achieve efficient hardware inference.

item.title: [paper] Fiberpose: state-of-the-art fiber morphometry and instance segmentation with a distance-transform neural network
item.description: Fiberpose is a distance-transform neural network framework that reformulates fiber analysis to provide instance segmentation and morphometry in fibrous images.

item.title: [paper] A high-dimensional spatial-physical coupling operator for generalizable super-resolution of three-dimensional turbulent flows
item.description: A spatial-physical coupling operator extends standard convolution to a joint spatial-variable dimension, enhancing the super-resolution of three-dimensional turbulent flows.

item.title: [paper] Can Decision Models Replace LLMs in Real-World Contact Center Classification and Judging Tasks?
item.description: Decision models offer a cost-effective alternative to generative large language models for bounded contact center classification and judging tasks.

item.title: [paper] Symmetries of Counterfactuals: Identification and Testability of Counterfactual Maps from Covariate Heterogeneity
item.description: This work characterizes counterfactual maps consistent with data using symmetry groups and provides a test for assumed causal mechanism classes.

item.title: [paper] The Kernel Reality Check: Benchmarking and Distilling Efficient Attention at Scale
item.description: A systematic benchmark of kernelized attention methods reveals their performance gaps and efficiency limitations compared to standard softmax attention.

item.title: [paper] A Transformer-Derived Iterative Preconditioner
item.description: A transformer-derived iterative preconditioner called RAPID uses randomized mixing and sparse local corrections to improve matrix conditioning and accelerate conjugate gradient solvers without learned components.

item.title: [paper] The Shared Word: Evaluating Language Models on Dutch Word Puzzles
item.description: The Shared Word is a Dutch language benchmark built around open-vocabulary word puzzles to evaluate and compare the reasoning capabilities of large language models.

item.title: [paper] Projected Penalty-Gradient Tracking for Communication-Efficient Byzantine-Resilient Federated Learning
item.description: A projected penalty-gradient tracking framework enables communication-efficient, Byzantine-resilient federated learning over heterogeneous datasets by using compressed residual uploads and server-side state projections.

item.title: [paper] When Do Typed Decision Models Work in Transportation? Evidence from Travel Choice and Traffic Signal Control
item.description: Typed decision models combine natural-language understanding with structured action interfaces to achieve low inference latency and cost in transportation tasks like travel-mode choice and traffic control.

item.title: [paper] Code World Model 2.0: Towards Infinite Controllable Video Generation
item.description: Invoker-Render combines a bidirectional creation model with a causal four-step streaming model using progressive forcing to enable infinite, controllable video generation from structural proxies.

item.title: [paper] SWIR-cGAN: Synthesizing SWIR Bands Using VNIR Imagery from CBERS and AMAZONIA-1
item.description: A conditional generative adversarial network called SWIR-cGAN synthesizes short-wave infrared satellite imagery from visible and near-infrared bands to improve remote sensing capabilities.

item.title: [paper] Action-outcome coupling: a pre-investment feasibility audit for offline reinforcement learning in supply chain operations
item.description: Action-outcome coupling provides an algorithm-independent feasibility audit and upper bound for offline reinforcement learning in supply chain operations using historical logs.

item.title: [paper] Who Pays for Byzantine Robustness? Validity, Data-Share Dictatorships, and Fairness When Only a Few Hospitals Collaborate
item.description: An empirical audit of Byzantine-robust aggregation rules in clinical federated learning reveals how small client counts and dominant hospital data shares impact model fairness and robustness.

item.title: [paper] BRepA: Graph-Based B-Rep Pretraining for Unified CAD Understanding and Generation
item.description: BRepA is a graph-based self-supervised pretraining framework that reconstructs geometry and topology to improve data efficiency and generation quality in computer-aided design tasks.

item.title: [paper] Done, But Still Working: Anytime Evaluation of When Coding Agents Should Stop
item.description: Anytime evaluation of coding agents reveals the cost savings and risks of stopping execution early after self-tests pass instead of continuing work.

item.title: [paper] You Only Encode Once: Sub-Pixel-Shifted Frames for Arbitrary-Scale Remote Sensing Super-Resolution with 2D Gaussian Splatting
item.description: Sub-pixel-shifted Gaussian Splatting is an encode-once framework that synthesizes multi-phase low-resolution observations to achieve arbitrary-scale super-resolution in remote sensing images without requiring real multi-frame training sequences.

item.title: [paper] Born for the Task: Rethinking Quantum Chemistry with Foresighted Agentic Computing
item.description: BORN is a foresighted agentic computing framework that predicts the accuracy and runtime of algorithmic strategies to synthesize high-performance quantum chemistry programs on demand.

item.title: [paper] Impact of Pretraining Length, Model Size, and Annotation Budget on Downstream Clinical Tasks of Foundation Models in Radiotherapy
item.description: Masked image modeling pretraining on large-scale radiotherapy cone-beam CT scans demonstrates that pretext validation loss consistently predicts downstream clinical performance while parameter-efficient fine-tuning matches full fine-tuning.

item.title: [paper] Wear and Go: Calibration Free Sparse Inertial Motion Capture via Online Sensor Setup Estimation
item.description: MOSAIC is a calibration-free framework that recovers sparse inertial sensor setups from ordinary motion using a temporal and cross-sensor attention network to standardize measurements for pose estimation.

item.title: [paper] Beyond Attribute-Centric Fairness: Modelling and Mitigating Unified Bias Representation in Omni-modal Large Language Models
item.description: OmniDebias is a bias-centric debiasing method that extracts and mitigates a shared bias representation across attributes and modalities in omni-modal large language models while preserving legitimate task knowledge.

item.title: [paper] Stopping Is Not the Limit: Understanding and Eliciting Agent Capability in Long-Horizon Vulnerability Exploitation
item.description: SCoRe is a context management method that compacts agent context during exploit generation to overcome early stopping and significantly increase vulnerability exploitation capability.

item.title: [paper] RoadAnnoter: An AI-Assisted Desktop Tool for Semantic Segmentation Annotation of Road-Scene Images
item.description: RoadAnnoter is an open-source desktop application that integrates six human-in-the-loop annotation modes to streamline semantic segmentation for road-scene images and road safety research.

item.title: [paper] Learning Agent-Centric Vision-Language-Action World Models for Autonomous Driving
item.description: AgentWorld is an agent-centric vision-language-action world model that uses discrete agent tokens and geometric grounding for efficient reasoning and trajectory planning in autonomous driving.

item.title: [paper] SlideJev: Order-Stable and Tissue-Grounded Jev Decisions for Whole-Slide Pathology
item.description: SlideJev is a whole-slide pathology vision-language question-answering framework that eliminates answer-order bias and grounds decisions in tissue evidence by evaluating candidate answers in parallel against tissue data.

item.title: [paper] Outcome-Balanced PPO and Policy-Induced Flow Rectification for Flow-Based VLA Policies
item.description: An RL framework combining Outcome-Balanced PPO and policy-induced flow rectification optimizes flow-based vision-language-action policies to improve success rates on robotic manipulation benchmarks.

item.title: [paper] Harnessing Image Diffusion Prior for Photo-Realistic Video Restoration
item.description: Generative video restoration method that combines noise energy rebalancing, motion-aligned noise warping, a self-supervised denoising encoder, and decoupled temporal attention to improve visual quality, realism, and temporal consistency.

item.title: [paper] Path-Aligned Constraint Equivariance
item.description: Path-Aligned Constraint Equivariance framework enforces structural constraints in learned super-resolution of physical fields using a null-space parameterization of the velocity field and a constraint-respecting noise sampler.

item.title: [paper] Against Coercion: AI Alignment as a Synthetic Social Contract
item.description: Synthetic Social Contract framework treats human and digital actors as rational, reasons-responsive agents to resolve the incentive conflicts and risks of the current AI control paradigm.

item.title: [paper] LOCUS: Causal Support Windows for Attribute Control in Autoregressive Image Generation
item.description: LOCUS is a latent optimization framework for autoregressive image generation that routes test-time interventions to specific causal support windows to satisfy multiple attribute constraints.

item.title: [repo] SecFathy/otpkit
item.description: Otpkit is a Model Context Protocol server that creates disposable email addresses and phone numbers to automatically extract OTP codes and verification links.

item.title: [paper] When the tail is earned by its companions: measuring label dependence in long-tailed multi-label classification
item.description: Within-label estimand and statistic measure label dependence in long-tailed multi-label classification to show how often rare labels rely on frequent companion labels for recovery.

item.title: [paper] Beyond Co-Generation: Rethinking Jointness in Joint Audio-Video Generation
item.description: JointREPA is a representation alignment-based post-training method that improves semantic consistency and cross-modal coordination in joint text-to-audio-video generation models.

item.title: [paper] Propose & Verify: Fast Reflection Symmetry Detection via Harmonic Fields
item.description: Fourier Accelerated Symmetry Transform is a training-free framework that uses spherical-harmonic spectral computation to detect multiple reflection symmetries in 3D shapes quickly and accurately.

item.title: [paper] CaFe: Causally Faithful Conditional Traffic Scenario Generation
item.description: CaFe is a dual-stream diffusion-forcing traffic simulator that restricts inter-agent interactions to public beliefs to prevent private intent leakage and ensure realistic closed-loop scenario generation.

item.title: [paper] WATERFALL: Workflow for Adaptive Training with Evolutionary Reward Formulation and Automated Learning Loops
item.description: WATERFALL is an iterative population-based workflow that automates reward discovery in partially observable reinforcement learning environments using persona-conditioned generation and vision-language model evaluations.

item.title: [paper] Keeping Parts Honest: Isolated Part Graphs for Faithful Vision Transformer Explanations
item.description: Vision Transformer classifier represents each image as a graph of isolated parts to prevent information leakage across patches and produce faithful, interpretable predictions.
